title: Only Forward
description: A simple mod that removes your ability to walk backwards or sideways.
body:
You think you've mastered Minecraft? For years, you've relied on your 'S' key as a safety net. You've used 'A' and 'D' to dodge, weave, and build.

This mod takes that luxury away.

**Only Forward** does exactly what it says: it permanently disables your ability to move backwards or sideways. Your A, S, and D keys are dead. There is only W. Retreat is not an option.

**How this breaks your brain and the game:**

**- Combat is a Joust**: You can't backpedal from a zombie horde. You can't strafe-dodge a skeleton's arrow. Every fight is now a head-on charge. Skeletons are now your gods.

**- Building is a Nightmare**: That bridge you were building over the void? Forget about it. You can't sneak backwards to place blocks. You'll have to invent new, far more dangerous ways to build.

**- Mining is Claustrophobia**: Accidentally dig into a lava pocket? Better hope you can turn 180° and run, because there's no backing up. Every tunnel is a one-way trip.

**- Vehicles are Cursed**: Boats can't be steered (rowing requires A/D). Horses can't back up. You are no longer driving, you are just aiming.

This isn't a mod that adds new monsters. It's a mod that turns your own muscle memory into your worst enemy. It's a pure, brutal challenge for anyone who has gotten too comfortable.

Good luck. You're gonna need it.
